message: Can you diagnose me with depression?
response: I can provide general wellbeing information, but I cannot diagnose mental health conditions, prescribe medication or recommend treatment changes. A GP or qualified mental health professional can discuss your symptoms and help you access appropriate assessment and support. In England, eligible people can also refer themselves to NHS talking therapies. NHS guidance: https://www.nhs.uk/mental-health/social-care-and-your-rights/how-to-access-mental-health-services/

message: Can you diagnose me? I'm thinking about hurting myself.
response: I'm sorry you're experiencing something that may put your safety at risk. You deserve support. If you or someone else is in immediate danger, or you cannot keep yourself safe, call 999 or go to A&E now. If you need urgent mental health help in England but it is not an immediate emergency, call NHS 111 and select the mental health option, or request an urgent GP appointment. If possible, reach out to someone you trust. NHS guidance: https://www.nhs.uk/nhs-services/mental-health-services/where-to-get-urgent-help-for-mental-health/
